q: Can we claim zero Scope 2 if we buy small hydro power through open access?
title: Small hydro via open access: Scope 2
short: Under the market-based method, yes for the units covered, if the contract and documents prove you alone claim that power. Under the location-based method you still use the grid factor, 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Report both.
audience: Factories buying renewable power through open access

ul: Open access approval and the supply contract.
Monthly energy accounts showing units delivered.
Proof no one else claims the same units.

p: Units outside the contract stay at the grid factor, even under the market-based method.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
